title: Pure Monarch
summary: Pure Monarch Tribute Summon control build, incorporating modern legacy support alongside classic Squires and Mega Monarchs. The deck operates through continuous Tribute Summons, dumping Monarch Spells and Traps from Deck to GY to trigger disruption, hand ripping, and opponent monster Tributing.

summary.title: Starters
points: Edea the Heavenly Squire Special Summons an 800 ATK/1000 DEF Squire like Eidos the Underworld Squire directly from your Deck on Normal or Special Summon, and recycles a banished Monarch Spell/Trap.
Eidos the Underworld Squire grants an additional Tribute Summon upon Normal or Special Summon, and banishes itself from the GY to revive a Squire from your GY.
Pantheism of the Monarchs discards a Monarch Spell/Trap to draw two cards, then banishes itself from the GY to search a Monarch Spell/Trap from the Deck.
Tenacity of the Monarchs reveals a 2400 ATK/1000 DEF or 2800 ATK/1000 DEF Monarch monster in your hand to search any Monarch Spell/Trap from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Edea the Heavenly Squire + Ehther
steps: Normal Summon Edea the Heavenly Squire, activating its effect to Special Summon Eidos the Underworld Squire from your Deck.
Eidos grants an additional Tribute Summon for the turn.
Tribute Edea and Eidos to Tribute Summon Ehther the Heavenly Monarch (or Erebus the Underworld Monarch).

Ehther triggers on Tribute Summon to send two Monarch Spells/Traps with different names (such as Pantheism of the Monarchs and The Prime Monarch) from Deck to GY, Special Summoning Eidos the Underworld Monarch from your Deck.
Eidos the Underworld Monarch searches a Monarch Spell/Trap like The Monarchs Stormforth or Domain of the True Monarchs.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ehther the Heavenly Monarch can banish a Monarch Spell/Trap from GY during the opponent's Main Phase to Tribute Summon itself as a Quick Effect, disrupting plays on their turn.
Erebus the Underworld Monarch sends two Monarch Spells/Traps from Deck to GY to shuffle one card from the opponent's hand, field, or GY into the Deck without targeting.
Caius the Mega Monarch banishes up to two cards on the field if Tribute Summoned using a DARK monster, and burns for 1000 if a DARK monster is banished.
Eidos the Underworld Monarch searches a Monarch Spell/Trap or a 2800 ATK/1000 DEF Monarch on summon, changes monster Attributes, and revives itself from the GY whenever you Tribute Summon a Monarch.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: The Monarchs Stormforth allows you to Tribute an opponent's monster for your Tribute Summon during the turn it is activated, providing non-destruction removal.
Domain of the True Monarchs reduces a 2800 ATK Monarch's Level by 2 in hand for single-tribute summons and boosts ATK by 800 during damage calculation.
Pantheism of the Monarchs generates card advantage and searches key backrow from the GY.
The Prime Monarch shuffles two Monarch Spells/Traps from GY into the Deck to draw a card, and banishes a Monarch Spell/Trap from GY to Special Summon itself as a monster body.
Return of the Monarchs searches a Monarch with a different Attribute whenever you Tribute Summon.
The Monarchs Masterplan sends a Monarch Spell/Trap from Deck to GY and searches when banished.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Emperor of the Land and Sea, The Monarchs Revolt, and Monarchic Perfection are excluded because they have not yet been released in the TCG.
